books.section: Topic 3.13 Continuity and Change in Period 3

primary_sources: Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures, December 5, 1791

stimulus.text:
Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures, December 5, 1791:

“Not only the wealth; but the independence and security of a Country, appear to be materially connected with the prosperity of manufactures. Every nation, with a view to those great objects, ought to endeavour to possess within itself all the essentials of national supply. These comprise the means of Subsistence habitation clothing and defence.”
stimulus.source_note: Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures, December 5, 1791. Founders Online, National Archives. Public domain.

source: original; stimulus quoted from Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures, December 5, 1791, public domain.
stem: Congress adopted Hamilton's report except for his plan to pay subsidies to industry. What does that decision best show?

options.text: Even backers of strong government disagreed over federal power's reach.
Congress agreed with every single part of Hamilton's plan.
options.misconception: Congress left out the subsidies, so it did not agree with every part.

options.text: The report ended all debate about the economy for good.
options.misconception: Debate over federal power went on for years after the report.

options.text: Jefferson wrote the report for Hamilton himself.
options.misconception: Hamilton wrote the report; Jefferson was his leading critic.

rationales.A: Background: Congress took the tariffs but not the subsidies. Even Hamilton's backers drew a line at federal payments to industry.
rationales.B: Congress left out the subsidies, so it did not agree with every part.
rationales.C: Debate over federal power went on for years after the report.
rationales.D: Hamilton wrote the report; Jefferson was his leading critic.
rationales.general:
1. Congress took Hamilton's tariffs but left out his subsidies to industry.
2. Background from the books: Jefferson and his allies feared a strong national government directing the economy.
3. So even a Congress that backed Hamilton drew a line at federal payments to manufacturers.
4. The decision shows the reach of federal power was itself the argument.
Remember: what a body leaves out of a plan can matter as much as what it keeps.
